text:
maya: quick heads-up — during today's 17:00 UTC change window we need to cherry-pick a docs + wheel-signing fix into the py/ts SDK canary. we hit a signer-mismatch on staging wheel yesterday, want to coordinate publish + rollback criteria.

jamal: saw the error. i re-ran the signer job locally and it passed but CI showed timestamp drift on the signature. suggest: attempt re-sign with locked timestamp + SHA fallback.

sophie: for TS we can pin the dist-tag to `next` while we validate. for Py, hold back `latest` and publish under `rc` tag. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: publish job queued — py-sdk@rc.2 publish started by @maya. logs: https://ci.example/build/12345

ananya: i can draft the release notes cherry-pick and prepend a short blurb about the transient signing mismatch so users aren't surprised. do we want an explicit breaking note?

maya: proposed checklist: 1) cherry-pick commits (docs + sign-fix), 2) rebuild signed wheels using `wheel-sign --timestamp=ci`, 3) run smoke: `python -m pip install --index-url https://internal.pypi/simple py-sdk==1.4.3-rc.2`, 4) pin npm dist-tag for TS: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.3-rc.2 next`

```# rebuild & sign (example)
git checkout -b release/cherry-pick-rc origin/main
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
./scripts/build-wheel.sh
wheel-sign --key-id $KMS_KEY --timestamp ci dist/py_sdk-1.4.3-rc.2-py3-none-any.whl
pip install dist/py_sdk-1.4.3-rc.2-py3-none-any.whl --no-index --find-links ./dist
```

jamal: watch out: KMS rotation may be why signatures differ. i'll run the sign inside the same container image with the locked KMS env to reproduce. ETA ~20m.

sophie: if we can't get a reproducible re-sign, fallback plan: abort publish and upload unsigned wheel to internal bucket with a temporary index-url for Dedicated customers. not ideal but reduces customer impact.

maya: decision: attempt honest re-sign first. if CI fails, rollback the publish and open a rollback PR (remove tags + docs revert). who can monitor the publish window at 17:00?

ananya: i'll monitor release notes + staged docs and keep a running commentary in this thread. i'll ping #general if anything customer-facing looks off.

deploy-bot: publish job failed — signature verification failed for py-sdk@1.4.3-rc.2. see logs: https://ci.example/build/12345#fail

jamal: rolling back tags now: `git tag -d v1.4.3-rc.2 && git push origin :refs/tags/v1.4.3-rc.2` and `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk next`

maya: thanks jamal. created follow-up GH issue to investigate KMS timestamp drift and sign reproducibility, assigning to @jamal.

ananya: updated the release notes draft to mark the rc attempt as aborted — removed the breaking note for now until we have a clean publish.

sophie: will coordinate TS publish tomorrow morning (PT) after we confirm the signing fix.

maya: closing the loop here — treating this as a soft rollback, no customer impact expected. we'll cover root cause in the release retro and adjust publish runbook to include KMS-env pinning during sign. thanks all :pray:
